text:
marta: Deploy-bot started wave 3 (staggered shift). Target change window 02:30 UTC. We need confirm pinset + rollout gating for api/runtime/console/router. Any blockers?
deploy-bot: :robot_face: wave=3 started, owner=@marta, plan=staggered( api->runtime -> router -> console ), canary=1%, step=5m, auto-rollback=true
sam: I see a pinned runtime build in the infra dashboard: runtime@v8.3.0-rc2. Is that the one we're using?
jun: Confirmed pinlist in release notes draft. Pin table:
```
api: v2.14.1
runtime: v8.3.0-rc2 (quant-opt)
router: v3.2.0
console: v1.9.2
```
leo: runtime-rc2 has the new KV eviction change; perf looks fine in canaries but increased p95 under concurrent small requests by ~120ms. We should hedge for that in SLO checks.
ara: Can we shift the order to api->router->runtime->console so router warmup happens before runtime load? That might reduce p95 spikes. Thoughts?
marta: I'd prefer not to change order mid-window. Instead: keep api->runtime->router->console but add an extra canary hold before routing more traffic to runtime. Add a 10m manual-check gate after first 1% canary.
sam: OK. I'll add a manual gate to the deploy-bot plan and add a metric guard: runtime_p95 < 450ms and error_rate < 0.2% for 10m. If gate fails, deploy-bot will pause and signal for rollback.
jun: Adding rollout notes to release doc and console banner. Also including a quick rollback play: 1) pause, 2) pin back runtime to v8.2.6, 3) scale down runtime-rc. Ava will own rollback but not in this thread.
ops-bot: :warning: reminder: EU region scheduled maintenance overlaps by 30m with this window. Is cross-region routing handled?
leo: Good catch. We should limit EU traffic by region routing to avoid coincident maintenance. I'll flip region routing to fallback region for 15m during canary.
marta: Final checklist: pins locked in CI, manual gate added, SLO guards set, EU routing hedge, release notes updated, console banner live. If everyone +1, I'll flip the canary at 02:30 UTC.
ara: +1
sam: +1
jun: +1
leo: +1
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: wave=3 paused at manual_gate, awaiting approval from @marta. To advance run `/deploy-bot advance 3187654321` or click the gate in the console.
marta: advancing now.
deploy-bot: :rocket: wave=3 advanced to canary=1%, started 5m observation window. Will post status at 02:40 UTC or on fail.
ops-bot: :information_source: If rollback triggers, follow runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-rollback and notify #incidents.
deploy-bot: status update: canary metrics within SLOs, canary=1% -> schedule ramp to 10% in 5m.
marta: keeping a close eye, ready to abort if p95 > 450ms.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: ramp to 10% complete. No anomalies detected. Final ramp to 50% will be automated unless manual abort before 03:05 UTC.
sam: documented kernel-flag flip that caused minor p95 blip earlier; we should monitor that path for next 2 hours.
leo: noted. Will keep traces on for the next 2 hours.
deploy-bot: :tada: wave=3 completed rollout to 100% at 03:20 UTC. post-deploy checks passed. If any regressions, open a postmortem tag `deploy-wave3-regression`.
